Privacy and revenue-first web analytics 
Connect Stripe, Polar, Paddle and more, and Kobbe traces every sale back to the page and source it came from. Bots are filtered out, so the numbers are real. No cookies, no banners. 
Start free for 15 days 
Live demo 
 Bot filtering, seven checks on every visit before it counts. 
Bots stay out of your numbers 
Headless browsers, datacenter traffic, and referrer spam never reach your stats or your quota. VPN users still count. 
 How bot filtering works How bot filtering works 
 Revenue attribution, from the first visit to the paid checkout. 
See what every page earns 
Gross, net, and attributed revenue for every page, source, and campaign, through Stripe, Polar, Paddle, Shopify, and more. 
 How attribution works How attribution works 
 Cookieless analytics, with no banner and no personal data stored. 
Nothing for visitors to consent to

Questions, answered plainly 
 Will Kobbe slow my site down? 
No. The default tracker is about 2.5 KB gzipped, loads with defer so it never holds up your page, and is served from Cloudflare's global network. The full build with scroll tracking, cross-domain tracking, and Web Vitals is about 5 KB. 
 Will it work with my site? 
If your site can add a script tag, yes. There are step-by-step guides for 22 platforms, including WordPress, Shopify, Webflow, Framer, Next.js, Astro, and Google Tag Manager. 
 How do AI agents connect to Kobbe? 
Through the MCP server in the Kobbe CLI. Create a token under Agent access, add kobbe mcp to any MCP-compatible agent, and it can read your traffic, revenue, funnels, and campaigns, or set up goals and funnels for you. Tokens are scoped, destructive actions need typed confirmation, and agent access is included on every plan, trial too. 
 Can I bring my data from another tool? 
Yes. Import your history from Google Analytics, Plausible, PostHog, Fathom, Umami, Matomo, Cloudflare Web Analytics, Vercel Web Analytics, Rybbit, Ahrefs Web Analytics, Pirsch, Simple Analytics, or DataFast. By default Kobbe only fills the days before your first Kobbe pageview, so nothing gets overwritten. Funnels, realtime, and revenue attribution start from live Kobbe data. 
 Do I need a cookie banner for Kobbe? 
Usually no, not for Kobbe on its own. The default tracker is cookieless: no analytics cookies, no persistent browser identifiers, and no analytics request when Global Privacy Control or Do Not Track is on. Many sites run Kobbe without a cookie banner for analytics. You may still need one if other tools on your site use cookies, if you enable optional Kobbe features such as cross-domain tracking, or if your jurisdiction requires consent for analytics. Check what applies to your site and audience. 
 Is Kobbe GDPR friendly? 
Kobbe is built for GDPR-conscious analytics: cookieless by default, no raw IP storage in the app database, no persistent visitor profiles, and a published Data Processing Addendum for the hosted service. You remain responsible for your site's privacy notice, lawful basis, and consent where required. Read our GDPR overview and DPA. 
 Do I need a credit card to start the trial? 
No. Start with a 15-day free trial without entering a card. Add billing details when you are ready to continue after the trial. 
 How does event-based pricing work? 
Move the slider to pick your monthly event allowance for the whole workspace. You pay for capacity, not feature tiers. Upgrade or downgrade any time as traffic changes. 
 What happens if I exceed my event limit? 
When a workspace reaches its monthly cap, Kobbe stops ingesting new analytics events until the next monthly reset or you move to a higher tier.
